     THEN COUNT(*) END AS value FROM proxy WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND cause='timeout'

panels.title: 首 token · P95
panels.description: 从开始到模型首 token。包括后台记录到的 token。

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH points AS (SELECT 0 AS bucket, '首 token' AS metric, ttft_ms AS value FROM turns WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND ttft_ms IS NOT NULL),
    ranks AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric ORDER BY value) AS pos,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric) AS total FROM points)
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '首 token' AND pos = (total * 95 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "首 token P95" 
    FROM ranks

panels.title: Clash 拨号超时趋势
panels.description: 目标为 ChatGPT 或 OpenAI 域名，包含使用这些域名的其他应用流量。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) / 1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN cause='timeout' AND route='proxy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "经代理超时", SUM(CASE WHEN cause='timeout' AND route='direct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "直连超时"
      FROM proxy WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText:
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) / 1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN cause='timeout' AND route='proxy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "经代理超时", SUM(CASE WHEN cause='timeout' AND route='direct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "直连超时"
      FROM proxy WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 模型连接故障与回退
panels.description: 上游异常和回退为日志条数。不同事件可能来自同一轮请求。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) / 1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'ws_connect_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "WebSocket 连接失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'model_retry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "模型采样重试", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'prewarm_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "预热失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'http_fallback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "回退 HTTP"
      FROM upstream WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText:
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) / 1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'ws_connect_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "WebSocket 连接失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'model_retry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "模型采样重试", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'prewarm_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "预热失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'http_fallback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "回退 HTTP"
      FROM upstream WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: codex 组节点观测与拨号超时
panels.description: 蓝点是首次在连接日志里看到不同节点的时间，红点是 codex 组实际记录到的拨号超时。两条点列按同一时间轴对齐。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT t/1000.0 AS time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event='node_observed' THEN 2 END) AS "观测到不同节点",
    MAX(CASE WHEN event='timeout' THEN 1 END) AS "拨号超时"
    FROM clash_timeline WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.queryText:
SELECT t/1000.0 AS time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event='node_observed' THEN 2 END) AS "观测到不同节点",
    MAX(CASE WHEN event='timeout' THEN 1 END) AS "拨号超时"
    FROM clash_timeline WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: codex 组节点与超时明细
panels.description: 超时行的上一观测节点来自最近一条转发日志。节点变化行的时间以首次看到不同节点的连接为准。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT t/1000.0 AS "时间",
      CASE event WHEN 'node_observed' THEN '观测到不同节点' ELSE '拨号超时' END AS "事件",
      previous_node AS "上一观测节点", previous_t/1000.0 AS "上一观测时间",
      node AS "新观测节点",
      CASE cause WHEN 'connect_timeout' THEN '建立连接超时' WHEN 'dial_timeout' THEN '拨号超时' END AS "超时阶段"
      FROM clash_timeline WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText:
SELECT t/1000.0 AS "时间",
      CASE event WHEN 'node_observed' THEN '观测到不同节点' ELSE '拨号超时' END AS "事件",
      previous_node AS "上一观测节点", previous_t/1000.0 AS "上一观测时间",
      node AS "新观测节点",
      CASE cause WHEN 'connect_timeout' THEN '建立连接超时' WHEN 'dial_timeout' THEN '拨号超时' END AS "超时阶段"
      FROM clash_timeline WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 上游异常原因
panels.description: 按日志中明确的错误字符串分类。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE cause WHEN 'timeout' THEN '超时' WHEN 'refused' THEN '连接被拒绝'
      WHEN 'reset' THEN '连接重置' WHEN 'tls_handshake' THEN 'TLS / 握手' WHEN 'capacity' THEN '容量 / 429'
      WHEN 'dns' THEN 'DNS' ELSE '日志无明确原因' END AS "原因",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'ws_connect_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "WebSocket 连接失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'model_retry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "模型采样重试", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'prewarm_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "预热失败"
      FROM upstream WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND event != 'http_fallback' GROUP BY cause ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
targets.queryText:
SELECT CASE cause WHEN 'timeout' THEN '超时' WHEN 'refused' THEN '连接被拒绝'
      WHEN 'reset' THEN '连接重置' WHEN 'tls_handshake' THEN 'TLS / 握手' WHEN 'capacity' THEN '容量 / 429'
      WHEN 'dns' THEN 'DNS' ELSE '日志无明确原因' END AS "原因",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'ws_connect_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "WebSocket 连接失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'model_retry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "模型采样重试", SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'prewarm_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "预热失败"
      FROM upstream WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND event != 'http_fallback' GROUP BY cause ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.title: DNS 错误与代理超时
panels.description: 按时间分桶对照 Mihomo 日志。解析失败涵盖本机应用，上游取消单独显示在旁边的表里。

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH events AS (
        SELECT t, event FROM dns_events WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t, 'proxy_timeout' FROM clash_timeline WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND event='timeout'
      )
      SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)/1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN event='resolve_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "域名解析失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DNS 上游连接异常", SUM(CASE WHEN event='proxy_timeout' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "codex 组拨号超时"
      FROM events GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText:
WITH events AS (
        SELECT t, event FROM dns_events WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t, 'proxy_timeout' FROM clash_timeline WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND event='timeout'
      )
      SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)/1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN event='resolve_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "域名解析失败", SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DNS 上游连接异常", SUM(CASE WHEN event='proxy_timeout' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "codex 组拨号超时"
      FROM events GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: DNS 上游走向
panels.description: 按配置识别 DNS 上游，展示 Mihomo 记录的实际出站。连接与取消均以日志条数统计。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT target AS "DNS 上游", COALESCE(route, '未记录') AS "出站",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_routed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "连接有记录",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "异常",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "取消"
      FROM dns_events WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND event!='resolve_error'
      GROUP BY target, route ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 25
targets.queryText:
SELECT target AS "DNS 上游", COALESCE(route, '未记录') AS "出站",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_routed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "连接有记录",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "异常",
      SUM(CASE WHEN event='upstream_canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "取消"
      FROM dns_events WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND event!='resolve_error'
      GROUP BY target, route ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: DNS 日志明细
panels.description: 每行对应一条 Mihomo 日志。节点列仅在日志记录实际节点时展示。上游连接记录只证明到解析器的连接阶段。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t/1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "时间",
      CASE event WHEN 'resolve_error' THEN '域名解析失败' WHEN 'upstream_error' THEN '上游连接异常'
      WHEN 'upstream_canceled' THEN '上游连接取消' WHEN 'upstream_routed' THEN '上游连接有记录' END AS "阶段",
      target AS "DNS 上游 / 域名范围", route AS "出站", node AS "实际节点",
      CASE cause WHEN 'timeout' THEN '连接超时' WHEN 'dns' THEN '解析失败'
      WHEN 'refused' THEN '连接被拒绝' WHEN 'reset' THEN '连接被重置'
      WHEN 'tls_handshake' THEN 'TLS / 握手' WHEN 'canceled' THEN '取消'
      WHEN 'other' THEN '其他连接错误' END AS "原因"
      FROM dns_events WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 80
targets.queryText:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t/1000.0, 'unixepoch') AS "时间",
      CASE event WHEN 'resolve_error' THEN '域名解析失败' WHEN 'upstream_error' THEN '上游连接异常'
      WHEN 'upstream_canceled' THEN '上游连接取消' WHEN 'upstream_routed' THEN '上游连接有记录' END AS "阶段",
      target AS "DNS 上游 / 域名范围", route AS "出站", node AS "实际节点",
      CASE cause WHEN 'timeout' THEN '连接超时' WHEN 'dns' THEN '解析失败'
      WHEN 'refused' THEN '连接被拒绝' WHEN 'reset' THEN '连接被重置'
      WHEN 'tls_handshake' THEN 'TLS / 握手' WHEN 'canceled' THEN '取消'
      WHEN 'other' THEN '其他连接错误' END AS "原因"
      FROM dns_events WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 80

panels.title: 首 token、首次工具与总耗时
panels.description: 每条线使用该指标有记录的轮次。总耗时包含工具等待和已中断的轮次。

UNION ALL
SELECT (t / (CASE

    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE

    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) AS bucket, '首次工具' AS metric, tool_ms AS value FROM turns WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND tool_ms IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) AS bucket, '总耗时' AS metric, total_ms AS value FROM turns WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND total_ms IS NOT NULL),
    ranks AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric ORDER BY value) AS pos,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric) AS total FROM points)
    SELECT bucket / 1000 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '首 token' AND pos = (total * 95 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "首 token P95" , MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '首次工具' AND pos = (total * 95 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "首次工具 P95" , MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '总耗时' AND pos = (total * 95 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "总耗时 P95" 
    FROM ranks
    GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
targets.queryText:
WITH points AS (SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000

UNION ALL
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) AS bucket, '首次工具' AS metric, tool_ms AS value FROM turns WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND tool_ms IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000

panels.title: 轮次日志状态
panels.description: 横轴按轮次开始时间统计。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) / 1000 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'recorded_end' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "有结束记录", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'interrupted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "已中断", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "结束状态未观测"
      FROM turns WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 近期最慢的轮次
panels.description: 展示所选时段总耗时最高的 20 轮。

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT t/1000.0 AS time, ttft_ms AS "首 token", tool_ms AS "首次工具",
      total_ms AS "总耗时", tools AS "工具调用",
      CASE status WHEN 'interrupted' THEN '已中断' ELSE '有结束记录' END AS "状态"
      FROM turns WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND total_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: App Server RPC · P95
panels.description: 桌面端已匹配到的 JSON-RPC 返回耗时，含各类管理和后台请求。

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH points AS (SELECT 0 AS bucket, 'RPC' AS metric, ms AS value FROM rpc WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND ms IS NOT NULL),
    ranks AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric ORDER BY value) AS pos,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric) AS total FROM points)
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN metric = 'RPC' AND pos = (total * 95 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "RPC P95" 
    FROM ranks

panels.description: 分位数按每个时间桶内的已返回请求计算。

targets.rawQueryText:

    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) AS bucket, '返回' AS metric, ms AS value FROM rpc WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND ms IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT (t / (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END)) * (CASE
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 3600000 THEN 60000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 21600000 THEN 300000
    WHEN $__to - $__from <= 86400000 THEN 900000
    ELSE 3600000 END) AS bucket, '排队' AS metric, queue_ms AS value FROM rpc WHERE t >= $__from AND t < $__to AND queue_ms IS NOT NULL),
    ranks AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric ORDER BY value) AS pos,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, metric) AS total FROM points)
    SELECT bucket / 1000 AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '返回' AND pos = (total * 50 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "返回 P50" , MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '返回' AND pos = (total * 95 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "返回 P95" , MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '排队' AND pos = (total * 95 + 99) / 100
        THEN value END) AS "排队 P95"
